trial_court: Family Court, Pune, Marriage Petition No. A-582 of 1989
case_name: Chandrashekhar Trimbak Patwardhan vs Sau. Vaijayanti Chandrashekhar
facts_of_case: Petitioner-husband filed a petition for divorce against his wife on grounds of adultery and cruelty under Section 13(1)(i) and (i-a) respectively of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court dismissed the petition. This appeal is against that decision.

legal_principles.principle: The burden to prove an important and relevant fact lies with the party making the claim.
legal_principles.held: At any rate, the burden to prove this important and relevant fact was of the petitioner to discharge.
cited_cases: Chandrashekhar Trimbak Patwardhan vs Sau. Vaijayanti Chandrashekhar ... on 21 January, 1993

legal_principles.principle: The fact of a mother-daughter relationship does not shift the burden to examine the mother as a witness.
legal_principles.held: We do not think that the onus to examine the mother as a witness had shifted to the Respondent No. 1 from the petitioner son-in-law.
